source.author: cic
source.text: quamquam in aliis minus hoc mirum est, nemo enim est tam senex qui se annum non putet posse vivere; sed idem in eis elaborant, quae sciunt nihil ad se omnino pertinere: serit arbores, quae alteri saeclo prosint, ut ait Statius noster in Synephebis.
source.text_original: quamquam in aliis minus hoc mirum est, nemo enim est tam senex qui se annum non putet posse vivere; sed idem in eis elaborant, quae sciunt nihil ad se omnino pertinere:  serit arbores, quae alteri saeclo prosint, ut ait Statius noster in Synephebis.
source.text_english: Although this is less surprising in other men, for there is no one so old that he does not think he can live another year; yet these same men also exert themselves in things that they know in no way concern them at all: he plants trees that will benefit another generation, as our Statius says in the Synephebi.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: that he would still live for one more year
